verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview lists "workflows" among its built-in features, which points to a first-party automation capability. However, that is a single name-only mention with no documentation of what workflows do, how they are triggered, or that they run unattended. Event-triggered webhooks and the Zapier app are building blocks or third-party-hosted automation, so they add no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of workflow triggers and actions, evidence that workflows run autonomously in the background, any configuration or API detail, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It powers one-on-one, group, round-robin, and collective scheduling, with routing forms, workflows, payments, native video, and an app store of integrations.
